name: Sales
definition: Value of sales in the territory for the month (AUD).
how_to_read: Read alongside target and market share, not on its own.

name: Target
definition: The sales target set for the territory for the month (AUD).
how_to_read: Targets are set from the brand plan at the start of the year.

name: Sales vs target
definition: Sales as a percentage of target.
how_to_read: On track at 98% or above, watch from 90% to 98%, off track below 90%.

name: Gap to target
definition: Sales minus target for the month (AUD). Negative means behind target.
how_to_read: Shows the size of the shortfall or over-delivery in dollars.

name: Market share
definition: Our sales as a share of total market sales for the brand's market definition.
how_to_read: Shows whether we are winning against competitors, even when the market itself is growing or shrinking.

name: Market share change
definition: Change in market share versus the previous three months combined, in percentage points.
calculation: Market share (month) - market share (previous 3 months combined)
how_to_read: A fall while sales are still near target often means the market is growing faster than we are.

name: Reach
definition: Share of target customers in a segment seen at least once in the month.
good_direction: Higher is better, up to the target
how_to_read: Compare with the reach target for the product's priority. A P1 brand needs far higher A-segment reach than a P3 brand.

name: Reach gap
definition: Reach minus the reach target, in percentage points. Negative means below target.
how_to_read: Shows how far coverage of a segment is from what the brand's priority requires.

name: Frequency
definition: Average calls per customer reached in the month.
how_to_read: Under 80% of target is under-servicing; over 150% of target is over-servicing that takes time from priority brands.

name: Call rate
definition: Average calls per field day, across all products.
how_to_read: If field days are normal, a normal call rate with poor priority-brand coverage points to effort spent on the wrong customers or brands. If field days are low, a normal call rate is expected: the issue is time in the field, not where the effort goes.

name: Field days
definition: Field days worked as a percentage of available days.
how_to_read: A sharp drop usually means leave, vacancy or training, and it flows through to reach and sales.
